scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Arzule presents software and a managed service for finding, managing and measuring B2B partnerships.
explains_well: An ideal-partner query leads to named candidates, a partner profile and relationship-management screens.
unclear: The film moves from a new partner search to existing revenue and activity without showing how that partner produced those results.
scenario: Find distribution partners for a no-code-related business and inspect fit, relationship activity and attribution.
product_clear_basis: The ideal-partner form and distribution-channel goal make the workflow explicit; the earlier ASR pitch names partnership intelligence.

scenes.purpose: Move from manual partner lists to an ecosystem view.

lessons.keep: Start a recommendation demo with a precise audience and business goal.
lessons.avoid: Avoid letting existing dashboards look like immediate results of a newly generated recommendation.
lessons.open: Fit-score basis, prediction and attribution accuracy, service scope, revenue claims and all heard audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, enter a specific partner profile and inspect one candidate’s supporting evidence.
Carry that candidate through an approved outreach and a logged response before showing aggregate revenue.
